transcript.speaker: honeypot
transcript.text: Hello?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: This is Officer Michael Brennan with the IRS Criminal Investigation Division. Am I speaking with the taxpayer?

transcript.speaker: honeypot
transcript.text: What case number should I write down?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Case 44-IRS-2291. A federal warrant is already in your name for tax irregularities.

transcript.speaker: honeypot
transcript.text: I have not received a letter. Who signs that warrant?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Local law enforcement is being dispatched unless this is settled today. Do not hang up.

transcript.speaker: honeypot
transcript.text: Settled how? Say it once, slowly.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: You will buy government payment cards for eight thousand four hundred dollars and read me the codes.

transcript.speaker: honeypot
transcript.text: I have to walk to a store. I will call this number back.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: You cannot call back. Stay on this recorded line. I will wait ten minutes.

transcript.speaker: honeypot
transcript.text: I am stepping away with the handset. If this drops I will redial.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Do not speak to the local IRS office. They are not cleared on case 44-IRS-2291.
